docs.title: Quick Start
docs.text:
from m2fgb import M2FGBClassifier
model = M2FGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    max_depth=5,
    random_state=0,
)
model.fit(X_train, Y_train, A_train)

docs.title: m2fgb.M2FGB
docs.text:
Bases: BaseEstimator

Class that extends the LightGBM model to optimize for min-max fairness with an Sklearn interface. This is the base class for the M2FGBClassifier and M2FGBRegressor.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default fairness_constraint str

Fairness function to be optimize, by default "equalized_loss"

'equalized_loss' objective str

Learning objective, must be "binary" or "mse", by default "binary"

'binary' fair_weight float

Weight parameter of weighted objective, must be between 0 and 1, by default 0.5

0.5 n_estimators int

Number of boosting rounds, by default 100

100 learning_rate float

Learning rate of primal updates, by default 0.1

0.1 multiplier_learning_rate float

Learning rate of dual updates, by default 0.1

0.1 num_leaves int

Maximum number of leaves in a tree, by default 31

31 max_depth int

Max depth of a tree, by default -1

-1 min_child_samples int

Minimum number of samples in a leaf, by default 20

20 min_child_weight float

Minimum sum of hessian of samples in a leaf, by default 1e-3

0.001 colsample_bytree float

Fraction of columns sampled to build each new estimator, by default 1.0

1.0 reg_alpha float

L1 regularization weight, by default 0.0

0.0 reg_lambda float

L2 regularization weight, by default 0.0

0.0 random_state int

Random seed, by default None

None

docs.title: m2fgb.dual_obj_cls(subgroup, fair_weight, info, fairness_constraint='equalized_loss', multiplier_learning_rate=0.1)
docs.text:
This helper function will define a custom objective function for XGBoost using the fair_weight parameter.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default soubgroup ndarray

Array with the subgroup labels.

required fair_weight float

Weight of the fairness term in the loss function.

required group_losses list

List where the losses for each subgroup will be stored.

required mu_opt_list

List where the optimal mu for each subgroup will be stored.

required fairness_constraint str

Fairness constraint used in learning.

'equalized_loss' multiplier_learning_rate float

Learning rate used in the gradient learning of the dual, used only if dual_learning="gradient", by default 0.1

0.1

docs.title: utils.logloss_group(y_pred, y_true, subgroup, fairness_constraint)
docs.text:
For each subgroup, calculates the mean log loss of the samples.

Parameters:

Name Type Description Default y_pred ndarray

Predicted probabilities of the positive class.

required y_true ndarray

True labels of the samples.

required subgroup ndarray

Subgroup indicator for each sample.

required fairness_constraint str

Fairness constraint to apply. Options are: - "equalized_loss": Equalized loss across subgroups. - "positive_rate": Positive rate across subgroups. - "true_positive_rate": True positive rate across subgroups. - "true_negative_rate": True negative rate across subgroups.

required

Returns:

Type Description ndarray

Mean log loss for each subgroup.

Raises:

Type Description ValueError

If the fairness constraint is not supported.
